summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/30)

data.translation: we would card, spin, and also wash the linen

rationale: First Infectum-wa example, with explicit first-person plural and coordinated habitual linen-processing work; the existing wash/full sense suffices.

summary: quṣríwayna at MAC NE Famine/30 establishes Infectum-wa with first-person plural in a habitual sequence of carding, spinning and washing linen. Subsequent manure, pond and beating stages situate the process, without making a separate technical sense necessary.

The current German sense already includes the inherited English gloss to full!; preserve it verbatim. MAC NE Mem and Zin/30 repeats the existing story passage, with s in dkoqusri versus glossary ṣ; this is recorded as spelling variation, not proof of a phonological merger.
Check dkoqusri versus the inherited d̥koquṣri in Mem and Zin/30 against the recording/transcription before changing the entry spelling; the current quotation and its source attribution are retained.
